title: [review] provisioning.py:485: Session collision in create_no
description: Same issue as line 451 but in create_node_session(). Existing session for peer_host is silently overwritten without wiping cryptographic material. Should call _remove_session(existing, wipe=True) before creating new session.
close_reason: Fixed: create_node_session() now calls _remove_session(existing, wipe=True) before overwriting session, ensuring cryptographic material from existing sessions is properly wiped
